类 MemorySection

    • getKeys

      public Set<String> getKeys(boolean deep)
      从接口复制的说明: ConfigurationSection
      Gets a set containing all keys in this section. 获取包含此节中所有键的集合。

      If deep is set to true, then this will contain all the keys within any child ConfigurationSections (and their children, etc). These will be in a valid path notation for you to use. 若 deep 设为 true，则将包含任何子 ConfigurationSection（及其子节等）中的所有键。这些键将采用有效的路径表示法，便于你使用。

      If deep is set to false, then this will contain only the keys of any direct children, and not their own children. 若 deep 设为 false，则将仅包含直接子节的键，而不包含它们的子节。

      指定者:
      getKeys 在接口中 ConfigurationSection
      参数:
      deep - Whether or not to get a deep list, as opposed to a shallow 是否获取深层（deep）列表而非浅层（shallow）列表。 list.
      返回:
      Set of keys contained within this ConfigurationSection. 此 ConfigurationSection 中包含的键集合。

      指定者:
      getValues 在接口中 ConfigurationSection
      参数:
      deep - Whether or not to get a deep list, as opposed to a shallow 是否获取深层（deep）列表而非浅层（shallow）列表。 list.
      返回:
      Map of keys and values of this section. 此节的键与值的 Map。

    • getCurrentPath

      public String getCurrentPath()
      从接口复制的说明: ConfigurationSection
      Gets the path of this ConfigurationSection from its root Configuration 获取此 ConfigurationSection 相对其根 Configuration 的路径。

      For any Configuration themselves, this will return an empty string. 对于任何 Configuration 本身，此方法将返回空字符串。

      If the section is no longer contained within its root for any reason, such as being replaced with a different value, this may return null. 若此节因任何原因不再包含于其根配置中（例如被其他值替换），则可能返回 null。

      To retrieve the single name of this section, that is, the final part of the path returned by this method, you may use ConfigurationSection.getName(). 若要获取此节的单个名称（即此方法返回路径的最后一部分），可使用 ConfigurationSection.getName()。

      指定者:
      getCurrentPath 在接口中 ConfigurationSection
      返回:
      Path of this section relative to its root 此节相对其根配置的路径。

    • addDefault

      public void addDefault(String path, Object value)
      从接口复制的说明: ConfigurationSection
      Sets the default value in the root at the given path as provided. 按所提供的内容在根配置的指定路径设置默认值。

      If no source Configuration was provided as a default collection, then a new MemoryConfiguration will be created to hold the new default value. 若未提供源 Configuration 作为默认集合，则将创建一个新的 MemoryConfiguration 来保存新的默认值。

      If value is null, the value will be removed from the default 若 value 为 null，该值将从默认 Configuration 源中移除。 Configuration source.

      If the value as returned by ConfigurationSection.getDefaultSection() is null, then this will create a new section at the path, replacing anything that may have existed there previously. 若 ConfigurationSection.getDefaultSection() 返回的值为 null，则将在该路径创建新的节，并替换该处之前可能存在的任何内容。

      指定者:
      addDefault 在接口中 ConfigurationSection
      参数:
      path - Path of the value to set. 要设置的值的路径。
      value - Value to set the default to. 要设置的默认值。

    • set

      public void set(String path, Object value)
      从接口复制的说明: ConfigurationSection
      Sets the specified path to the given value. 将指定路径设置为给定值。

      If value is null, the entry will be removed. Any existing entry will be replaced, regardless of what the new value is. 若 value 为 null，则该条目将被移除。无论新值是什么，任何既有条目都将被替换。

      Some implementations may have limitations on what you may store. See their individual javadocs for details. No implementations should allow you to store Configurations or ConfigurationSections, please use ConfigurationSection.createSection(java.lang.String) for that. 某些实现可能对可存储的内容有限制，详情参见它们各自的 javadoc。任何实现都不应允许存储 Configuration 或 ConfigurationSection，此类需求请使用 ConfigurationSection.createSection(java.lang.String)。

      指定者:
      set 在接口中 ConfigurationSection
      参数:
      path - Path of the object to set. 要设置的对象的路径。
      value - New value to set the path to. 要将该路径设置为新值的值。

      从接口复制的说明: ConfigurationSection
      Creates an empty ConfigurationSection at the specified path. 在指定路径创建一个空的 ConfigurationSection。

    • createPath

      public static String createPath(ConfigurationSection section, String key)
      Creates a full path to the given ConfigurationSection from its root Configuration. 从给定 ConfigurationSection 的根 Configuration 创建到达该节的完整路径。

      You may use this method for any given ConfigurationSection, not only MemorySection. 你可以对任何给定的 ConfigurationSection 使用此方法，而不仅限于 MemorySection。

      参数:
      section - Section to create a path for. 要为其创建路径的节。
      key - Name of the specified section. 指定节的名称。
      返回:
      Full path of the section from its root. 该节相对其根的完整路径。

    • createPath

      Creates a relative path to the given ConfigurationSection from the given relative section. 从给定的相对节创建到达给定 ConfigurationSection 的相对路径。

      You may use this method for any given ConfigurationSection, not only MemorySection. 你可以对任何给定的 ConfigurationSection 使用此方法，而不仅限于 MemorySection。

      参数:
      section - Section to create a path for. 要为其创建路径的节。
      key - Name of the specified section. 指定节的名称。
      relativeTo - Section to create the path relative to. 创建相对路径所相对的节。
      返回:
      Full path of the section from its root. 该节相对其根的完整路径。
